content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DCPU Cuddalore Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.cuddalore.tn.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Cuddalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the DCPU Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 is 25 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant cum Bench Clerk post in the District Child Protection Unit Cuddalore recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Office Assistant post, candidates must have passed the 8th Standard or its equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the DCPU Cuddalore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Assistant cum Record Clerk position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these government jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DCPU Cuddalore Recruitment 2026 primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the verification of their documents.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment drive requires an offline application. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for DCPU Cuddalore?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Child Protection Unit Cuddalore is https://www.cuddalore.tn.nic.in. You can find the official notification and application form here.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions advertised by the District Child Protection Unit Cuddalore are on a contractual basis.
